title: Retry a visually unreadable picture once without relaxing independent review
steps: Run generated low-mean bright-patch, fallback, independent-look replay and lifetime fingerprint fixtures.
expect: A low-mean picture rejected solely for text readability receives exactly one recorded transform and a fresh independent look before fallback.
Subject faults, cut-outs and verified covering template overlays receive no readability retry; unknown overlays grant no exemption.
Crash replay reuses cached independent looks; completed and later-round manifests do not transform the same candidate again.
Processing semantics change the run lifetime fingerprint while role prompt hashes stay unchanged.
fence: No real models, customer-site writes, prompt changes or visual acceptance exemptions.

tests: a low-mean bright patch receives one readability transform and a fresh independent look before fallback
mixed readability and subject failures advance fallback without any transform or extra look
replaying the original or completed manifest reuses deterministic files and cached independent looks
cut-outs and verified template overlays never receive a readability retry
an unknown template mask does not exempt a candidate and repeated readability failure advances fallback
a previously retried source cannot receive another transform when reintroduced in a later round
picker fix rounds preserve transformed bytes and retry history when the same original candidate is selected
a transformed picture cannot pass without a readable independent verdict
processing policy changes the run lifetime fingerprint without changing role prompt hashes
